materialPipeline.scope: Synthetic local images and generated short test clips, full material generation, integrity checks, import, native compilation and waiting overlay rendering. No model, real application or account CLI was launched.

nativeControl.scope: Isolated fake local service and own native control window; 30 window open/close cycles, preview file unlocking and disposal, two pet actions, no real application or account CLI launched. Short idle sample is not long-term performance proof.

startupPerformance.scope: One local comparison, no real app relaunched. Pet measurement excludes worker/network, frame decoding and host readiness delay; not a whole cold-start guarantee.

nativeTcpTest.scope: Own short-lived loopback listeners only; no application launch or remote connection.

scope: Clean ZIP build, static checks and isolated fixture tests. No AI image generation, production account query or real application launch. Full interactive npm test was not certified by this review.
